summary: Iteration 4: tested the ICF estimator, Waterproofing checklist, Crew packets/reports and Job-site photos on both backend and frontend. Backend: 15 fast tests + 8 slow E2E tests with real Gemini on project TEST_Iter4 Set, 23/23 passed. Frontend: tabs, ICF editing/recalc, WP filters and verify persistence, crew packet prepare->running->ready, ICF crew PDF download, photo upload->analyzing->analysis->follow-up->reanalyze->delete all work. One spec'd element is missing: icf-zero-warning.

minor.issue: Unverified checkbox char '☐' (U+2610) is not in Helvetica and renders as a filled black square, which looks like 'checked'. 'MEDIUM' wraps to 'MEDIU M' in the 0.55in Sev column.
Page header always says '<project> · Takeoff report' even on crew packets.
Stores raw cell values from the UI. Edited numeric cells are saved as strings (e.g. '8'). The calc handles this via num(), but the stored data types become mixed.
No guard against starting a tool again while it is running, so duplicate Gemini jobs race to write.
If a follow-up fails, the whole photo status is set to 'failed' even though the analysis is still valid. The user then must reanalyze before asking again.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid icf-zero-warning does not exist in IcfEstimator.jsx. There is no warning when walls have height 0 (Smith project shows 0 blocks/0 yd³ with no banner). Only the AI 'missing' list mentions it.

integration_issues.issue: runTool has no try/catch, so an API error gives an unhandled promise rejection and no toast.

issues: Project tabs overflow horizontally: 'Waterproofing' is cut off and 'Job photos' is hidden. It scrolls, but there is no visual cue.
ICF wall grid needs horizontal scroll (acceptable).

action_items: Add icf-zero-warning banner in IcfEstimator when any wall has height_ft 0/empty (or totals are 0 while walls exist)
Replace '☐'/'✓' table glyphs in wp_section with Helvetica-safe text (e.g. 'No'/'Yes' or '[ ]'/'[x]') or register a DejaVu font; widen Sev column
Make PDF header say 'Crew packet' for crew reports
Coerce numeric ICF cell values to numbers before PUT (frontend) or in edit_icf
Wrap CrewState.prepare in try/catch with toast; optionally reject tool start when already running (409)
Do not mark photo as failed when only a follow-up fails
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 769 lines (>700): split tools/photos/report routes into modules
ICF calc verified by hand: example gives 196 straight/24 corner/29.87 wall cy/11.2 footing cy; waste=0 gives 186. Waste is not applied to corner blocks (may be intended)
With height 0, rebar still includes dowels + footing bars (711 lb on Smith). This is plausible but worth stating in the UI
